testProvenance.ordinaryFlows: Three real original-model/public-pilot record flows perform actual first placement, bank B undo, exact same-ID/same-endpoint repair and connected completion. Positive gameplay is ordinary input evidence, not snapshot forcing.
testProvenance.ordinaryEdgeStates: Thirty-three canvas states come from unchanged authored puzzles. Additional ordinary inputs cover held inventory, same-island/length/color/through-island/occupied refusals, exact undo,3-by4 diagonal, last-piece local legality with global disconnection, genuine disconnected loss,3-invalid loss and90s timeout.
testProvenance.crossingFixture: One named fixture changes first4 public island grid coordinates to[(0,0),(4,3),(0,3),(4,0)] and P1/P2 lengths to5 on an original create-state. Ordinary inputs then place one diagonal and attempt the crossing diagonal. This is explicitly a visual boundary fixture, not an authored puzzle, a normal full flow, a victory or a recording. The34 count is33ordinary+1fixture.
testProvenance.coverageHistory: An initial pre-generation assertion assumed all6 local rejection types were reachable in authored prefixes.
